description: This file contains unit tests for the SerializationServiceImpl class within the org.openmrs.api.impl package. It tests the behavior of setting serializers in the SerializationServiceImpl class, including resetting and restoring the serializer list.

classes.name: SerializationServiceImplTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the behavior of SerializationServiceImpl related to managing serializers.

methods.name: clearSerializers
methods.description: Stores the current serializers and clears the serializers in a new SerializationServiceImpl instance before all tests.

methods.name: setSerializers_shouldNotResetSerializersListWhenCalledMultipleTimes
methods.description: Tests that calling setSerializers multiple times appends serializers without resetting the list.

methods.name: restoreSerializers
methods.description: Restores the original serializers after tests are run, resetting the SerializationServiceImpl to its previous state.
